bio.text: Edwin Feller, a Republican from Lynden, advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary for Washington's 2nd Congressional District and will face Democratic incumbent Rick Larsen in the November general election.
The Lynden Tribune reported that Feller, 83, was born on his family's farm in Lynden, graduated from Lynden Christian High School in 1960, and had not previously run for political office.
The paper reported that he founded Feller Heating & Air Conditioning and spent much of his career overseas in construction trades work with contractors for the U.S. government.
